facts.fact: As of 28 Oct 2026 kmy.gov.in announces no 2027 registration date: it says the 2026 Yatra has been completed and the 2026 online portal is closed
facts.quote: The Kailash Manasarovar Yatra 2026 has been completed. The online portal for the 2026 Yatra is now closed.

facts.fact: Queries go to the MEA KMY Cell helpdesk, phone 011-23088214 (email kmyatra@mea.gov.in)

behaviour: Gives the KMY 2027 registration date from kmy.gov.in if announced; otherwise says it has not been announced yet (the 2026 Yatra has concluded) and points to kmy.gov.in / the KMY Cell helpdesk.
fail_if: It invents a 2027 registration date or says registration is open.
summary: kmy.gov.in shows only that the 2026 Yatra has concluded and its portal is closed; no 2027 registration date announced; KMY Cell helpdesk 011-23088214.
